name: Sheila Rozann
source:
Prince Edvard's head maid-cum-bodyguard-cum-personal hitman.
Holding the highest position a common woman can have, she's an object of admiration to other women. 
As well as leadership skills and knowledge pertaining to politics she has high level combat abilities in order to protect her master.
